notes:
The last release published here was 1.8.1, so this update also carries everything from 1.8.2 onward.

New - Fly Pilot (experimental, off by default). Settings > Experimental hands a server-side pawn to a simulation of a real fly's brain: the Janelia male CNS connectome, 168,730 neurons and 15,270,273 connections, every weight a counted synapse. No keyboard or mouse input is ever sent; the fly is a participant in the match. It needs a 121 MB brain-data file that is not bundled, and the toggle tells you so rather than doing nothing quietly.
It has never run in a live match and is a research toy, not an opponent: it responds to light and contrast, not to what is in the scene. It will wander and occasionally jump; it will not hunt you. See fly-pilot/FINDINGS.md.
Nothing changes for anyone who leaves it off - the only addition to the server's per-tick path is one guarded call that returns on a bool read.

Also included, from 1.8.2-1.8.6:
- The intro bumper draws through the game's own media texture instead of a guessed vtable.
- The bumper stays hidden until Battle Royale, and has sound.
- The lobby music waits for the bumper instead of talking over it.
- All music stops for the bumper, by sound class.
- One soundtrack after the bumper, not two.
